name: part-editor
description: Studio's part editor for text-to-cad parts: the part's script stays its source, and the engineer changes its sizes and dimensions by hand, each change one number edited in the script.

interface.shortDescription: Change a part's sizes by hand
interface.longDescription: Shows a text-to-cad part beside the thread as a design: a timeline read from its code, its named sizes, and dimensions on the model. Changing one changes the number in the script behind it and rebuilds the part.
